response.rationale: R2 is the most complete causal-anatomic diagnosis: the calcified invasive gallbladder wall plus solid heterogeneous gallbladder mass locate the primary tumour and explain the liver invasion and metastases. R3 describes only the downstream pulmonary-CT finding and does not identify the primary site, so it is a complication/staging label rather than the most likely diagnosis.
